gloss: trunk; torso; body (of an object); chest protector

definitions.explanation: The central part of the body, without the head and limbs; also the middle of an animal's body.

definitions.gloss: body (of a drum, instrument, or vessel); chest protector (kendo)
definitions.explanation: The main, central part of an object such as a drum, guitar or ship. In kendo, the armour that protects the torso, and a strike to it.

notes:
An everyday but slightly technical word; in ordinary talk about the body, ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧ or ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧ is more common, and {胴|どう} appears mainly in compounds and set phrases.

- {胴上|どうあ}げ: tossing someone into the air in celebration
